name: Home Bakery and Cake Business System in Excel – True Cost per Cake
html:
Know the true cost and the right price of every cake, which orders really make money and which days your oven cannot take – before you quote the next wedding cake or promise a Friday delivery. This is a complete back office for a home bakery or cake studio in Excel: eight connected workbooks that already work with sample data, so you see every alert and dashboard before you type your first order.

Built for owner-bakers with a few bakers and decorators selling custom celebration cakes, cupcakes, cookies, bread and pastry boxes to private clients and events, plus standing wholesale orders for cafes, shops and market stalls.

What you get:

  • 8 connected workbooks: recipe costing and pricing; orders, quotes and deposits; production plan and order calendar; ingredient stock and waste; allergens, labels and product range; delivery, pick-up and markets; wholesale accounts and client payments; profit, cash flow and growth
  • 552 ready pages: dashboards, calculators, printable forms and checklists, and ready WhatsApp messages
  • 15 languages, each as a blank template, with filled sample-data copies in English
  • Standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice – no macros, no subscription

How it works: 1) open the workbook in your language, 2) type your recipes, prices, orders, stock and hours in the yellow cells, 3) cost per serving, quote prices, deposit alerts, oven load, allergy checks, overdue invoices and profit per order update by themselves. One payment, instant download.

What it does for you

  • Know the true cost of every cake by servings, tiers, decoration, packaging and labour
  • Quote a custom cake in minutes with price, delivery fee, deposit and margin worked out
  • Set the price from your target margin and stop selling cakes below cost
  • See every ingredient price rise reach the cost of all your recipes at once
  • Collect every deposit and balance on time, and never lose a quote without a reply
  • Plan each day inside your oven trays, fridge slots and team hours
  • Know the day to bake and the day to decorate for every due date
  • Buy only what the week needs, with a shopping list and a use-first list
  • Cut waste with its cost and reason, and find stock count gaps while they are small
  • Check every allergy note against the cake and print ingredient labels before the bake
  • Plan deliveries, pick-ups and market stock, and see the real profit of each stall
  • Invoice cafes and shops on time and see your cash 13 weeks ahead with a safe owner draw

Do I need special software?
No. The files are standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice, which is free.

Does it fit a home baker and a bigger cake studio?
Yes. It works for one baker and for a studio with several bakers and decorators; the sample data shows an owner-baker, a head baker, two bakers, two decorators, 24 products, 38 ingredients, 6 wholesale accounts and about 2,800 orders.

Can I replace the sample data with my own?
Yes. Every workbook comes in 15 languages as a blank template, plus filled sample-data copies in English, so you can explore first and start clean when you are ready. Each fact is typed once and every dashboard reads it from there.

Can I use my own currency, units and targets?
Yes. Currency, prices, margin targets, deposit shares, delivery zones, oven and fridge capacity and sales tax are on the settings and list sheets, and every formula follows your changes. For food-safety rules, check your own local rules.

Where do I start?
Start with Part 1 to cost your recipes and set prices, or with the part that hurts most today, such as orders or stock. Each workbook works alone and links to the others as you fill it.

Are there macros or a subscription, and how do I receive it?
No macros and no subscription. You pay once and download a ZIP at once with every workbook in all 15 languages.
seo: Run your bakery from 8 connected Excel workbooks: cake costing, quotes, production plan, stock, allergens, deliveries, wholesale and profit. 15 languages.
